about: Labelled training examples for the embedding intent classifier. NOT an evaluation set -- the classifier is fitted on these, so its accuracy here is reported for reference and never gated. Grown twice. 64 to 118, because 64 examples across three classes is thin for any classifier and the weakest measured set was intent_queries at 0.7083; measured afterwards, that round contributed nothing and is documented as having contributed nothing. Then 118 to 154, for a reason that was not an accuracy point: a screenshot of the running app showed a policy question about working from home being routed to applyLeave, and the app attempting to file five days of casual leave. Scored on the 36 retrieval paraphrases -- 36 policy questions no intent fixture contained -- the classifier sent 14 to a leave action. The cause was distribution, not method: the policyQuestion class was dominated by leave-policy wording, so a first-person sentence with a day or a time in it read as a leave action whatever it asked about. The 36 examples added cover attendance, payroll, IT, expenses, grievance, medical, exit and conduct questions in first-person phrasing, with six of each leave intent so the class prior is not merely pushed toward policyQuestion. eval/held_out_intent_queries_5.json was written before any of them existed. eval_intent.js measures the nearest-neighbour similarity between every evaluation query and this file and fails the build above 0.92, so growth here cannot quietly become leakage.
